meta_description: Nimbus Locksmiths provides fast emergency lockout and lock repair services across Stockport and Greater Manchester. 24/7 response, no call-out charge.
hero_subhead: Locked out in Stockport? We arrive within the hour, any time of day or night—no call-out charge.
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to security upgrades, we handle every lock problem with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Lockouts
services.desc: Locked out of your home or office? We'll have you back inside within 45 minutes, 24/7. No damage, no fuss, no hidden charges.

services.title: Lock Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Broken locks, worn hinges, or snapped keys? We repair or fit new locks on doors, windows, and safes—all with quality hardware that lasts.

services.title: Burglary Repairs
services.desc: Break-in? We secure your property fast with emergency boarding, lock changes, and damage assessment to help with insurance claims.

services.title: Residential Security Upgrades
services.desc: Improve home security with multi-point locks, deadbolts, and anti-snap cylinders fitted by experienced locksmiths in Stockport.

services.title: Commercial Lock Fitting
services.desc: We install and maintain locks on commercial properties, office buildings, and retail units—with keying services tailored to your needs.

services.title: Lock Picking & Safe Opening
services.desc: Can't find the key to an old lock or safe? We open them safely without damage, using professional techniques.

about_pullquote: We answer the phone when others don't—because emergencies don't happen in office hours.
about_para_1: Nimbus Locksmiths has been serving Stockport and Greater Manchester for 12 years. Started by locksmiths frustrated with slow response times, we built the business around one promise: be there fast, fix it right, charge fairly. Today, we handle over 1,000 jobs a year, from burst locks to full security upgrades.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on showing up on time, treating customers with honesty, and never overcharging. Most jobs are sorted on the first visit. We're local, we answer 24/7, and we don't hide behind call centres—you'll speak to a locksmith who can help you immediately.
reviews_heading: What Stockport Residents Say About Nimbus Locksmiths

reviews.text: Got locked out of my house on a Sunday evening and they arrived in 40 minutes. No faffing about, no call-out charge, and a really fair price. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Our office door lock jammed mid-morning and they came out the same day. Professional, quick, and they didn't overcharge us like other locksmiths tend to. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Had a break-in and rang them in panic. They got here in less than an hour, boarded up the window, and changed all the locks. Proper job and they even helped with the insurance paperwork.
reviews.author: David M.
